1	"""Advisory health checks for the human/agent-maintained work queues.
2	
3	These checks deliberately never mutate state or fail a command.  They make the
4	workspace-hygiene guidance executable and visible to every CLI caller while
5	leaving room for a human or agent to decide that an unusually large collection
6	is intentional.
7	"""
8	
9	from __future__ import annotations
10	
11	from collections.abc import Sequence
12	from dataclasses import dataclass
13	from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
14	
15	from .clock import utc_now
16	from .inbox import InboxItem, InboxKind, InboxStatus
17	from .roadmap import RoadmapItem, RoadmapStatus
18	from .tasks import HorizonTask, TaskStatus
19	
20	
21	@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
22	class AdvisoryHealthLimits:
23	    """Central defaults for CLI collection-health warnings."""
24	
25	    open_memories: int = 10
26	    open_info: int = 4
27	    open_inbox: int = 30
28	    open_tasks: int = 12
29	    active_roadmap: int = 8
30	    stale_running_task_hours: int = 24
31	
32	
33	DEFAULT_HEALTH_LIMITS = AdvisoryHealthLimits()
34	
35	
36	def _as_utc(value: datetime) -> datetime:
37	    """Normalize legacy naive timestamps before comparing their age."""
38	    if value.tzinfo is None:
39	        return value.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
40	    return value.astimezone(timezone.utc)
41	
42	
43	def inbox_health_warnings(
44	    items: Sequence[InboxItem], limits: AdvisoryHealthLimits = DEFAULT_HEALTH_LIMITS
45	) -> list[str]:
46	    """Warnings for an inbox whose open working set may need pruning."""
47	    open_items = [item for item in items if item.status is InboxStatus.OPEN]
48	    warnings: list[str] = []
49	    counts = {
50	        kind: sum(item.kind is kind for item in open_items)
51	        for kind in (InboxKind.MEMORY, InboxKind.INFO)
52	    }
53	    if counts[InboxKind.MEMORY] > limits.open_memories:
54	        warnings.append(
55	            f"Inbox has {counts[InboxKind.MEMORY]} open memory items "
56	            f"(recommended maximum {limits.open_memories}) — archive stale, "
57	            "superseded, or no-longer-key memories if this is not intentional."
58	        )
59	    if counts[InboxKind.INFO] > limits.open_info:
60	        warnings.append(
61	            f"Inbox has {counts[InboxKind.INFO]} open info items "
62	            f"(recommended maximum {limits.open_info}) — archive notices that "
63	            "have been consumed if this is not intentional."
64	        )
65	    working_set = [item for item in open_items if item.kind is not InboxKind.PROTECTION]
66	    if len(working_set) > limits.open_inbox:
67	        warnings.append(
68	            f"Inbox has {len(working_set)} open non-protection items "
69	            f"(recommended maximum {limits.open_inbox}) — review duplicates and "
70	            "stale items; use `inbox complete` or `inbox archive` where appropriate."
71	        )
72	    return warnings
73	
74	
75	def task_health_warnings(
76	    tasks: Sequence[HorizonTask],
77	    limits: AdvisoryHealthLimits = DEFAULT_HEALTH_LIMITS,
78	    *,
79	    now: datetime | None = None,
80	) -> list[str]:
81	    """Warnings for an oversized task queue or apparently orphaned runs."""
82	    open_statuses = {TaskStatus.QUEUED, TaskStatus.RUNNING, TaskStatus.BLOCKED}
83	    open_tasks = [task for task in tasks if task.status in open_statuses]
84	    warnings: list[str] = []
85	    if len(open_tasks) > limits.open_tasks:
86	        warnings.append(
87	            f"Task queue has {len(open_tasks)} open tasks "
88	            f"(recommended maximum {limits.open_tasks}) — review whether some "
89	            "objectives are done, blocked, cancelled, duplicated, or better kept "
90	            "only as roadmap milestones."
91	        )
92	
93	    cutoff = _as_utc(now or utc_now()) - timedelta(hours=limits.stale_running_task_hours)
94	    stale = [
95	        task for task in tasks
96	        if task.status is TaskStatus.RUNNING and _as_utc(task.updated_at) < cutoff
97	    ]
98	    if stale:
99	        shown = ", ".join(task.id for task in stale[:4])
100	        more = f" (+{len(stale) - 4} more)" if len(stale) > 4 else ""
101	        warnings.append(
102	            f"Task(s) {shown}{more} have remained running for more than "
103	            f"{limits.stale_running_task_hours}h — confirm a run is still live or "
104	            "reset their status if it ended unexpectedly."
105	        )
106	    return warnings
107	
108	
109	def roadmap_health_warnings(
110	    items: Sequence[RoadmapItem], limits: AdvisoryHealthLimits = DEFAULT_HEALTH_LIMITS
111	) -> list[str]:
112	    """Warnings when too many roadmap milestones claim simultaneous focus."""
113	    active = [item for item in items if item.status is RoadmapStatus.ACTIVE]
114	    if len(active) <= limits.active_roadmap:
115	        return []
116	    return [
117	        f"Roadmap has {len(active)} active items "
118	        f"(recommended maximum {limits.active_roadmap}) — consider marking "
119	        "deferred work pending, or leave the broader focus active intentionally."
120	    ]
